headline: Stonecradle Tilts Colonial as Weathered Expanse Stays Fluid
war_summary: Since the last filing, Stonecradle has shifted, the line now standing six Colonial strongpoints to three Warden, and casualty rolls there have climbed sharply in the latest two-hour interval. Weathered Expanse remains the liveliest sector of the war, twenty-seven recorded base events over the past day and another conversion logged within the most recent six hours; the present line is five Colonial strongpoints to four Warden, with no strategic position lying neutral. Dead Lands, quiet for a time, has stirred with fresh base events in the past two hours, the most active point being Callahan's Gate, leaving that sector for the moment wholly Colonial. Linn Mercy still shows ten Colonial strongpoints to one Warden and Mooring County twelve Warden strongpoints, neither having moved in the newest two-hour window; Stlican Shelf stands unchanged at six Warden to three Colonial. Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line continue to grind with heavy losses while their strategic bases remain fixed. No victor has been declared.
